sections.html:
acquire

(verb). nhận được, đạt được

Ex: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.

arise

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: We keep them informed of any changes as they arise.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

commonplace

(adjective). Phổ biến

Ex: This technology is now commonplace in schools.

constraint

(noun). sự hạn chế

Ex: This decision will impose serious constraints on all schools.

controversy

(noun). tranh cãi

Ex: The controversy surrounding his latest movie continues.

deliberately

(adverb). cố ý, chủ tâm

Ex: She's been deliberately ignoring him all day.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

enable

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.

exhibit

(verb). trưng bày, phô bày

Ex: The three novels exhibit a growing confidence in the author's use of language.

facilitate

(verb). tạo điều kiện

Ex: Structured teaching facilitates learning.

flee

(verb). chạy trốn

Ex: They fled to Britain when the war started.

forage

(verb). tìm kiếm thức ăn

Ex: The female only leaves the young when she forages for food.

gradually

(adverb). dần dần

Ex: Over the next three weeks, the effect gradually returned.

hamper

(verb). cản trở

Ex: Our efforts were severely hampered by a lack of money.

hypothesis

(noun). Giả thuyết

Ex: There is little evidence to support these hypotheses.

ignorant

(adjective). dốt nát

Ex: Never make your students feel ignorant.

incur

(verb). mang lại kết quả không mấy tốt đẹp

Ex: She had incurred the wrath of her father by marrying without his consent.

indicate

(verb). chỉ ra, hiển thị

Ex: The survey data indicate a general satisfaction with the process.

instinctive

(adjective). thuộc bản năng

Ex: My instinctive reaction was to deny everything.

knowledgeable

(adjective). hiểu biết rộng

Ex: She is very knowledgeable about plants.

maintain

(verb). duy trì, khăng khăng

Ex: The men maintained that they were out of the country when the crime was committed.

naive

(adjective). ngây thơ

Ex: I can't believe you were so naive as to trust him!

observe

(verb). Quan sát

Ex: I want you to observe all the details.

occurrence

(noun). lần xuất hiện, sự xảy ra

Ex: The program counts the number of occurrences of any word within the text.

opposing

(adjective). đối lập nhau

Ex: This behaviour is based on a conflict between two opposing forces within the individual.

potentially

wrath

communication

tool

twig

advocate

question

(verb). nghi ngờ

theory

guide

(adjective). tương tự

gain

(noun). cách tiếp cận, phương pháp

Ex: The problem is being tackled with a range of measures.

conservative

(adjective). bảo thủ, cổ hủ

Ex: The southern state's inhabitants tend to be socially conservative.

resistant

(adjective). Kháng lại

Ex: Mosquitoes are becoming resistant to insecticides.

sector

(noun). khu vực

Ex: We have seen rapid growth in the services sector.

according to

(preposition). theo

Ex: The salary will be fixed according to qualifications and experience.

vulnerable

(adjective). dễ bị tổn thương

Ex: Old people are particularly vulnerable to the flu.

process

(noun). quá trình

Ex: It's a normal part of the learning process.

record

(noun). ghi chép

Ex: You should keep a record of your expenses.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

account for

(verb). đóng vai trò, chiếm

Ex: The Japanese market accounts for 35 per cent of the company's revenue.

emission

(noun). Sự thải

Ex: Bioluminescence is the emission of light from living organisms.

governmental

(adjective). Thuộc về chính phủ

Ex: Should there be governmental intervention in currency markets?

total

(noun). tổng cộng, toàn bộ

Ex: His businesses are worth a combined total of $3 billion.
